_note: One set of references, one translation per locale. The references are language independent by design: the model picks a reference, and each locale resolves it in its own version. Adding a language means adding an entry to versions, not touching this list.

pt-BR.note: 129 = NVI (Nova Versao Internacional, Biblica Inc.), granted through the account's Bible licence. All rights reserved, which is why this repo is private. Regenerate against BLT (id 3254, CC BY-SA) before making it public. Note the /bibles?language_ranges[] listing does NOT report 129 for pt even when access works - direct passage access is the authority, not the listing.

en.note: 206 = World English Bible, public domain. Chosen over NIV (111, also served by this key) precisely because it is public domain: English adds no new licence obligation, so it is the locale that could ship publicly first. Verified by direct passage access on NEH.4.6, not by the version listing.

_chapters_note: Every chapter a CITED verse lives in must appear here, or the reader's 'Saber mais' opens an empty chapter and CLAUDE.md rule 12 is broken: the citation may be deferred, the access never. Only NEH.4 was fetched, so 7 of the game's 9 citations had a dead button and deep_read - the north-star metric - could only fire on two lines. 1CO.13 and NEH.3 are deliberately absent: no line cites them, and fetching a chapter with no beat attached would ship licensed text the game never shows.
